forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8b80
+title: 'Decide the future of ShortTimeoutSession: the web fetcher now removes its timers'
+---
+## What
+Card `^q586aqm` made the outer `runCode` timeout the only time limit of a web request. `WebFetcher` now copies the caller's `URLSessionConfiguration` and sets `timeoutIntervalForRequest` and `timeoutIntervalForResource` to `.infinity`, and it sets `URLRequest.timeoutInterval` to `.infinity` on each request.
+
+Thus `ShortTimeoutSession` (`Tests/Support/MultitoolTestSupport/ShortTimeoutSession.swift`) has no effect on a web request. The live web suites of `IntegrationTests/` (`LiveSearch.makeSessionConfiguration()`, `LiveFetch`, `WebRunCodeLiveTests`, `WebResearchScenarioTests`) still give it short timeouts, and their comments still say "with short timeouts". A probe also showed that the request timer had no effect before: `prepare` always set an explicit `timeoutInterval`, and an explicit request value replaces the session value.
+
+`ShortTimeoutSessionTests` still pass, because they test only the configuration object.
+
+## Decide
+- Remove `ShortTimeoutSession`, its tests, and the timeout constants of the live suites, and correct their comments; or
+- keep a live-test bound in another form that obeys the rule "the only timeout is the outer runCode timeout".
+
+A person must choose. This card records the gap; it does not choose.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No comment in `IntegrationTests/` or `MultitoolTestSupport` says that a short session timeout bounds a live web request.
+- [ ] `cd IntegrationTests && swift build --build-tests` passes. #timeouts #web
\ No newline at end of file
